results.title: Ensuring Quality Forecasts with Databricks Lakehouse ...
results.content: Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring is built to monitor the statistical properties and quality of data across all tables, but it also includes specific capabilities tailored for tracking the performance of machine learning models via monitoring inference tables containing model inputs and predictions. To monitor a forecasting model, create an inference profile monitor on the table containing the model's input features, predictions, and optionally, ground truth labels. After creating an inference profile monitor for your forecasting model, you need to periodically refresh it to update the metrics with the latest data. When you create an inference profile monitor for your forecasting model, Lakehouse Monitoring generates several key assets to help you track data drift, model performance, and overall health of your pipeline. In addition to the metrics tables, Lakehouse Monitoring automatically generates an interactive dashboard to visualize your forecasting model's performance over time. Once you have an inference profile monitor set up for your forecasting model, you can define alerts on key metrics to proactively identify issues before they impact business decisions.

results.title: Model monitoring for ML in production: a comprehensive ...
results.content: * **Model monitoring** includes tracking metrics related to model quality (e.g., accuracy, precision, etc.), data and prediction drift, data quality, model bias, and fairness. > **TL;DR:** Production ML monitoring tracks the quality of the model performance on live data. Model monitoring tracks the quality of individual ML models, which may involve checking their input data quality. There is some overlap between data and model quality monitoring – especially at the implementation level when it comes to specific tests and metrics you can run, such as tracking missing data. Model monitoring covers various metrics and aspects of ML model quality on top of the quality of the input data – from model accuracy to prediction bias. Since an ML-based service goes beyond just the ML model, the ML system quality has several facets: software, data, model, and business KPIs. Each involves monitoring different groups of metrics. You can use data drift analysis as a monitoring and debugging technique for production ML models to evaluate if the model still operates in a familiar environment.

results.title: Self-Healing AI Models: Detecting & Fixing Their Own ...
results.content: A combination of numerous important research fields, including mistake detection, model fine-tuning, lifetime learning, and occasionally meta-learning, form the basis of self-healing AI. Key topics include supervised learning and error propagation, mistake detection techniques, lifetime learning, meta-learning, and pertinent research on model adaptation and feedback loops are covered in this chapter, which offers a fundamental overview of the ideas behind self-healing AI. Enabling models to learn continuously — that is, to update their internal representations in response to new input without forgetting past knowledge — is one of the main problems in creating self-healing AI. A base model for task-specific predictions, an error detection module that detects possible misclassifications, and an adaptive correction mechanism that starts self-repair are the three main components of the system’s modular design. The idea and use of self-healing AI models — systems that can recognize their own errors and adjust through structured feedback and retraining — were examined in this thesis.
